items.doc: How hard the leveler works, percent: the one knob. It reads the declared table (LEVELER_AMOUNT_POINTS and the rows beside it) for the threshold, ratio and make-up of the downward slot and the threshold, ratio and largest boost of the upward one, linear between the table's points. 0 is the input, bit for bit, the come-up value.

items.doc: Which way the leveler works, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: down, a compressor over the loud passages; up, an upward compressor under the quiet ones (omx_dyn's UPWARD law); both, the two in series, down first. Both comes up.

items.doc: How fast the leveler follows, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: slow, medium, fast; each an attack and a release from LEVELER_SPEED_ATTACK_MS and LEVELER_SPEED_RELEASE_MS. Medium comes up.
